en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a dense low-rise neighborhood of flat-roofed houses in the foreground, labeled as an Arab village, with a large fortified citadel on a hill in the background. On top of the citadel stands a prominent mosque with a central dome and tall minarets, overlooking the cityscape. Printed captions appear along the bottom edge and a faint circular stamp mark is visible on the left. There is also a modern website watermark across the lower right.
